Submit a defined incremental load only after project scope and rights are confirmed; require a utility capacity/cost/schedule offer. The 1,140 kW nameplate is not added capacity. No application was submitted.

claim.en: The March 13, 2024 Court of Appeals opinion A23A1381, reproduced by Justia and FindLaw, describes the disputed Suwanee Electrify America site as four charging ports (two rated 150 kW and two rated 350 kW), six power cabinets rated 190 kW each, and a 1,140 kW total cabinet nameplate rating. Georgia Power supplied AC through one meter.
claim.zh: Justia及FindLaw转载的2024年3月13日上诉法院A23A1381判决，描述涉案Suwanee Electrify America旧站有4个充电接口（2个150 kW、2个350 kW）、6个各190 kW功率柜，总铭牌功率1,140 kW，由Georgia Power通过单一电表提供交流电。

limitation.en: Court-authored text is accessed through secondary hosts; the opinion identifies the Suwanee dispute, while the original PSC subpoena supplies the street-address join. These are historic existing-EA equipment facts, not current 2026 as-built verification, observed utilization, transformer capacity, or spare/reserved capacity for a new eight-stall project.
limitation.zh: 法院原文经次级网站访问；判决指明Suwanee争议，PSC原始传票用于关联具体门牌。这是既有EA旧站的历史设备信息，不是2026年竣工复核、实际利用率、变压器容量或新增8车位项目的可用/预留容量。

claim.en: The Supreme Court of Georgia official list records denial of certiorari on February 18, 2025 in S24C0906, explicitly linked to A23A1381. The earlier appellate opinion affirmed the decision authorizing Georgia Power to serve this historical EA installation.
claim.zh: Georgia最高法院官方名单记载，2025年2月18日拒绝对S24C0906复审，并明确关联A23A1381；此前上诉判决维持Georgia Power为该历史EA设施供电的裁定。

limitation.en: The denial is verified on the court website; the substance of the earlier decision is read through a court-opinion mirror. This resolves a historical supplier dispute, not a new service commitment, current tariff election, technical expansion approval or a Supreme Court merits ruling.
limitation.zh: 拒绝复审直接核自法院网站；此前判决内容经法院文书转载读取。该记录解决的是历史供电争议，不是新供电承诺、当前适用电价、扩建技术许可或最高法院对实体问题的重新裁判。

claim.en: The original January 11, 2022 subpoena in PSC docket 43899 names Johns Creek Town Center, 3630 Peachtree Parkway, and requests AC/DC meter readings and metered demand/usage/load for March 1–December 31, 2021, plus OCPP configuration and power-limit records.
claim.zh: PSC案卷43899的2022年1月11日原始传票指明Johns Creek Town Center、3630 Peachtree Parkway，要求提供2021年3月1日至12月31日交流/直流电表读数、计量需量/用量/负荷，以及OCPP配置和功率限制资料。

limitation.en: No response containing those measurements was retrieved. A request for data is not data. Item 6 concerns a 250 kVA transformer at Cookeville, Tennessee, not this Suwanee site. Even historic delivered energy would not establish current paid sessions or incremental Tesla demand.
limitation.zh: 尚未取得含这些实测数据的答复。要求提供数据不等于取得数据。第6项所述250 kVA变压器位于Tennessee的Cookeville，不能套用于Suwanee；即使取得历史电量，也不能证明当前付费次数或新增Tesla需求。

claim.en: DCFC Tracker lists this exact address with four CCS stalls and a posted $0.64/kWh price. The final page opened in this audit attributes that price to Electrify America with a September 3, 2026 source date.
claim.zh: DCFC Tracker在该准确地址列出4个CCS车位和$0.64/kWh挂牌价；本轮最后打开的正文将价格来源标为Electrify America、日期为2026年9月3日。

limitation.en: Earlier retrieval exposed a different freshness date, so cached freshness is inconsistent. The official EA page did not expose station details in retrieved text. This is an unverified secondary posted-price snapshot, not a current confirmed price, realized net price, paid-order count or revenue; no underwriting input is replaced.
limitation.zh: 前次抓取显示不同的新鲜度日期，缓存日期存在不一致；EA官方页面的可读正文没有显示站点细节。这是未获官方确认的次级挂牌价快照，不是已确认的当前价格、实收净价、付费订单或收入，不替换承销模型输入。

claim.en: The July 23, 2024 SEC filing for Johns Creek Town Center uses an April 3, 2024 rent roll and lists Sprouts expiry as September 30, 2029 with two five-year options. Big V announced its acquisition with Equity Street Capital on June 11, 2024.
claim.zh: 2024年7月23日SEC披露中的Johns Creek Town Center资料使用2024年4月3日租赁表，列示Sprouts于2029年9月30日到期、另有两次5年续租选择权。Big V于2024年6月11日公告与Equity Street Capital的收购。

limitation.en: These are dated owner/issuer disclosures, not an executed charging-site lease or current title confirmation. Renewal exercise, EA exclusivity, parking easements, mortgage/tenant consent and EV rent/revenue share are unverified. Property acquisition, mortgage and retail operating costs are not EV capex or opex.
limitation.zh: 这些是有日期的业主/发行人披露，不是已签署的充电场地合同或当前产权确认。续租是否行权、EA排他条款、停车地役权、抵押权人/租户同意及充电租金/分成尚未核实；地产收购、贷款和商场运营费用不能替代EV资本与运营成本。

claim.en: Georgia PSC publishes a written Open Records Act request route through its Open Records Officer at openrecords@psc.ga.gov. The precise next document targets are docket 43899 subpoena responses, the January 2022 hearing exhibit index, public technical exhibits, the adopted initial/final orders, and any public versions of withheld material.
claim.zh: Georgia PSC公布了向Open Records Officer（openrecords@psc.ga.gov）提交书面公开记录申请的路径。下一步具体文件是43899案传票答复、2022年1月听证证据目录、可公开技术附件、获采纳的初步/最终裁定，以及受限资料的公开版本。

limitation.en: No request was submitted. Live PSC page access failed DNS in shell/browser; indexed original documents remained accessible. The docket table did not render records. scope.en: Conditional delivery + Schedule 201 supply subtotal including four verified per-kWh riders, with an explicitly inferred Schedule 290 core-charge mapping. Not a complete utility bill or site qualification.

numericInputs.meaning: Schedule 30 secondary combined energy before separately listed riders

loadSizeDefinition.en: Average of the two greatest nonzero monthly demands within the trailing 12 months including current month; this is not automatically the current billing peak.
loadSizeDefinition.zh: 含当月的前12个月两个最高非零月需量的平均，不自动等于当月计费峰值。

monthlyDemandDefinition.en: Greatest metered 15-minute use, rounded to nearest kW, minimum 100 kW.

assumptions.en: Assume utility approves Schedule 30 secondary and Schedule 201 supply; assume meter voltage matches delivery voltage; assume steady history gives load size equal to each stated monthly peak. These are analytical inputs, not site observations.
assumptions.zh: 假设公用事业批准30号二次侧与201号供能、计量电压等于供电电压，且稳定历史令负荷规模等于列示月峰值；均为分析假设，并非场地实测。

riderSource.note: Current original tariff PDFs read 2026-10-30. Indexed Schedule 291 search excerpt was stale (2025 percentage-based scheme), so the opened current 2026 PDF controls this analysis. No BPA credit deducted.

limitations.en: Still excludes unknown reactive charges, meter-voltage adjustments and special-contract conditions. Schedule 290 mapping is an explicitly stated inference. Assumes Schedule 201 cost-based supply, secondary service, rate eligibility and no rider-cap adjustment. Repeated 1,200 kW remains outside Schedule 30. No full bill, firm capacity or approved local tariff assignment obtained.
limitations.zh: 仍未计未知无功费、计量电压调整及特别合同条件。290号映射明确为推导。假设201号成本供能、二次侧服务、适用资格成立且无需附加费封顶调整。反复1,200kW仍超出30号范围；未取得完整账单、确定容量或获批当地费率类别。

riderApplicabilityAssumptions.en: Separate ordinary charging account, no self-direction or aggregated-site exemption/cap applies, annual charging energy below 8,760 MWh; monthly grid energy remains below 724,638 kWh and 5,000,000 kWh. Test caps at actual site/account level, not only at the charger meter.
riderApplicabilityAssumptions.zh: 假设独立普通充电账户，无自主管理或合并场地减免/封顶，年度充电电量低于8,760MWh，月购电低于724,638kWh与5,000,000kWh。封顶须按实际场地/账户判断，不能只看充电电表。

publishedBasis.en: 1.5% of billed electricity, distribution, ancillary, metering/billing, transition and other cost categories included in electric rates on July 23, 1999. The price summary marks 1.5% on Schedule 30 basic, load-size, demand, energy and reactive rows.
publishedBasis.zh: 按电力、输配、辅助、计量/账务、过渡费及1999年7月23日电价已包含的其他成本类别计1.5%。费率汇总在30号基本费、负荷规模、需量、电量和无功行标注1.5%。

mapping.en: Apply 1.5% to the documented core basic/load-size/demand/combined-energy subtotal, then add the four separately stated kWh riders. Do not compound 1.5% onto those riders without utility confirmation. This billing mapping must be checked against an actual utility bill.
mapping.zh: 对已列明核心基本费/负荷规模/需量/合并电量小计计1.5%，再加四项单列按电量附加费；未经供电方确认，不对附加费再次复乘1.5%。该账单映射仍须与实际电费单核对。

implementationMapping.formula: monthlySubtotal = 1.015 * (basic + loadSizeRate * assumedLoadSizeKw + 13.07 * monthlyDemandKw + 0.06537 * monthlyGridKwh) + 0.01293 * monthlyGridKwh

rounding.en: Keep full precision through calculation, round the resulting displayed bill; utility line-by-line rounding may differ.
rounding.zh: 计算保留精度，最终显示金额再取舍；供电方逐项舍入可能不同。

route.zh: 通过商业/工业申请及工程规划师现场会议取得RFP、费率类别和客户变压器范围；先书面确认申请费，再取得供电设计及EPC/运维/租约报价，排除住宅估算器数值。本轮未申请或付款。

summary.zh: 已有明确公用事业询问/设计路径；场地剩余容量、接电价格及送电日期仍未确认。

route.zh: 工程部门360-501-9546/newservice@cowlitzpud.org须核实实际负荷、供电电压、接入源及地役权；索取签署的容量/延伸工程报价与总送电排期，公开移交后安装周期不可替代总排期。

provider.zh: WinCo/物业方及附近充电运营商

route.en: With owner/operator permission, request anonymized 12-month paid transaction and downtime export; if no installed station, commission a bounded local observation and competing-station demand study. No outreach performed.
route.zh: 经业主/运营商许可索取12个月匿名交易及停机数据；尚未安装充电站时，开展有明确范围的现场观察及竞争站需求研究。本轮未对外联系。

summary.en: Published tariff and/or engineering process is available; no scoped complete charger-project cost or binding quote found.
summary.zh: 可获得公开费率及/或工程流程；未找到有明确范围的完整充电项目成本或约束性报价。

neededDocument.en: Current itemized EPC quotation plus utility connection quote, rent/lease and commercial terms, software/payment/O&M/insurance/tax/replacement costs; inclusions, exclusions, contingency and validity.
neededDocument.zh: 当前分项EPC报价、供电接入报价、租金/租约及商业条款、软件/支付/运维/保险/税费/更换成本；含范围、排除项、预备金和有效期。

route.en: Obtain utility design/quote first; request matching-scope EPC and 10-year operating quotations. Store remodeling valuations and conditional incentives are excluded from confirmed cost.
